info.title: Outreach API
info.description: REST API for the outreach platform. Every operation runs the same database function the web app uses, as the member who created the key, limited to the key's role and client scope. Caps, schedules, warm-up, reply-stop and suppression are enforced in the database, so the API cannot send more than the app can. Guide: docs/outreach/API.md.

post.summary: What we POST to your webhook URL
post.description: Headers: x-signature (hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the webhook secret), x-event, x-delivery-id. Answer 2xx within 10 seconds. Up to 5 attempts with backoff.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a retry safe. Same key and same request replays the first answer; same key and a different request answers 409 E_IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH.

message.description: Plain sentence. Safe to show to a person.

request_id.description: Quote this when you ask for help.

details.description: Present on some errors, for example retry_after on E_RATE_LIMITED.

Totals.description: The same keys everywhere a report returns numbers. Rates are percentages with one decimal, null when the denominator is 0.

acceptance_rate.description: Percentage with one decimal. null when the denominator is 0.

reply_rate.description: Percentage with one decimal. null when the denominator is 0.

interested_rate.description: Percentage with one decimal. null when the denominator is 0.

positive_reply_rate.description: Percentage with one decimal. null when the denominator is 0.

negative_reply_rate.description: Percentage with one decimal. null when the denominator is 0.

open_rate.description: Percentage with one decimal. null when the denominator is 0.

click_rate.description: Percentage with one decimal. null when the denominator is 0.

bounce_rate.description: Percentage with one decimal. null when the denominator is 0.

cohort.description: The leads the funnel was computed for (date range and filters).

profile.description: Enriched profile: about, experience, education, skills, languages, posts.

suppressed.description: Why the lead cannot be contacted, or null.

LeadInput.description: Send linkedin_url, public_identifier, provider_id or an email so the lead can be matched. Unknown keys are rejected.

email_work.description: Filled only when the lead has no work email yet. Never overwritten.

email_personal.description: Filled only when empty. Never overwritten.

custom.description: Custom fields. Merged key by key: keys you leave out keep their value.

client_id.description: Filled only when the lead has no client yet.

provider_id.description: LinkedIn member id, when you have it.

source.description: Free label stored on new leads. Default: api.

LeadPatch.description: Only the fields you send change. A field you leave out is never blanked. Empty strings and nulls count as left out. Unknown keys are rejected.

email_work.description: Filled only when the lead has no work email yet. Never overwritten.

email_personal.description: Filled only when empty. Never overwritten.

custom.description: Custom fields. Merged key by key: keys you leave out keep their value.

client_id.description: Filled only when the lead has no client yet.

held_at.description: Set while the lead is held after a reply.

sender_id.description: Force one sender from the pool. Leave out to use the sequence's assignment rule.

include_replied.description: Also enrol leads who replied recently. Default false.

wait_enrichment.description: Hold each lead at the start until its profile is enriched.

confirm.description: Must be true. Without it the call answers E_CONFIRM_REQUIRED.

excluded.description: reason → {count, sample_ids}. Reasons: not_in_workspace, suppressed:<why>, replied_recently, already_enrolled, no_fresh_sender.

variant_id.description: '' when the step has no variants. Sum the rows of a node for its total.

Budget.description: action type → {cap, used, reserved} for today in the sender's timezone.

capacity.description: action type → effective daily cap right now.

failures.description: Consecutive failed deliveries. The webhook is switched off at 50.

secret.description: Shown once. Used to verify x-signature.

client_ids.description: Empty means every client the member can see.
